skill.displayName: AI Buzz Cut Filter Online – API-powered
skill.summary: AI buzz cut filter — change a person's hairstyle to a buzz cut

latestVersion.changelog:
buzz-cut-ai-openapi-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of buzz-cut-ai, an AI skill for changing a person’s hairstyle to a buzz cut.
- Supports uploading and processing a single portrait image per request.
- Utilizes WeShop OpenAPI endpoints for image upload, agent execution, and run status polling.
- Requires a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable for authentication; guides users on secure API key handling.
- Allows optional custom hairstyle instructions and batch image generation (up to 16).
- Provides endpoint and parameter details for seamless integration.
